Name: Vanilla Seeds and Saplings
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b]Tired of running to Pierre's or JojaMart just to buy seeds?[/b]

[b]Introducing Vanilla Seeds and Saplings, an add-on for Kenneth's Seed Shop that lets you buy all vanilla seeds and saplings right on your farm![/b]

[b]All items are added to Shop 3 of Kenneth's Seed Shop building.[/b]

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
[b]- Adds 53+ vanilla seeds, starters, and tree saplings to Kenneth's Seed Shop
- Includes all seasonal seeds plus rare/unbuyable items like Ancient Seeds, Cactus Seeds, Banana & Mango Saplings, Mushroom Tree Seed, Mystic Tree Seed, Tea Sapling, Pineapple Seeds, Taro Tuber, Qi Bean, and more
 [/b]
[b]ABOUT THE PRICE:[/b]
[b]Prices are 2x, 3x, or even 10x more expensive![/b]

[b]Why?[/b]
[b]1. Convenience Fee - You can now buy everything directly on your farm, no need to run to town every time you need seeds.
2. Rare Items - Some seeds in this pack are not normally buyable in the vanilla game (Ancient Seeds, Qi Beans, etc.). Since they are now available to purchase, they come with a premium price to keep the game balanced.
[/b][b]If you want an easier life on the farm, you have to pay the price![/b]

[b]REQUIREMENTS:[/b]
[b]- Kenneth's Seed Shop (Main Mod) - REQUIRED
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

[/b][b]INSTALLATION:
[/b][b]1. Install the main Kenneth's Seed Shop mod first
2. Place this add-on folder into your Mods folder
3. Run the game via SMAPI
4. Visit Kenneth's Seed Shop and check Shop 3

[/b][b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b]
[b]- Works with existing saves
- Safe to add or remove anytime

Code and Concept by Kf29[/b]
